Test of Page Creation

```{r}
# Load the required libraries
library(magick)
library(exifr)

# --- User-configurable settings ---

# 1. Set the whitespace around the image (in inches). 
#    A smaller number means a larger image. Good values are 0.5 to 1.0.
page_margin_inches <- 0.1

# 2. Set the image scale factor within the margins.
#    1.0 = fill the space completely (up to the margins).
#    0.9 = use 90% of the available space.
image_scale_factor <- 1.0


# --- Main script ---

# 1. Select the JPG file interactively
image_path <- file.choose()
if (length(image_path) == 0) {
  stop("No file selected. Please run the script again.")
}

# 2. Read all available metadata
exif_data <- read_exif(image_path)

# --- EXIF Inspector (to find your caption field) ---
cat("--- Potential Caption Fields Found ---\n")
common_fields <- c(
  "ImageDescription", "DateTimeOriginal", "Description", "City", 
  "Title", "Event", "Location")
found_caption <- FALSE
for (field in common_fields) {
  if (field %in% names(exif_data) && !is.na(exif_data[[field]])) {
    cat(sprintf("Field: %s\nText: %s\n\n", field, exif_data[[field]]))
    found_caption <- TRUE
  }
}
if (!found_caption) {
  cat("No text found in common descriptive fields.\n")
}
cat("------------------------------------\n\n")

# 3. Define the caption text
# >>> ACTION REQUIRED <<<
# Change "ImageDescription" below to the correct field name you found above.
caption_field_name <- "Description" 
caption_text <- ifelse(
  !is.null(exif_data[[caption_field_name]]), 
  exif_data[[caption_field_name]], 
  " " # Default to blank if field doesn't exist
)
location_field_name <- "Location" 
location_text <- ifelse(
  !is.null(exif_data[[location_field_name]]), 
  exif_data[[location_field_name]], 
  " " # Default to blank if field doesn't exist
)

# 4. Read the image and define the PDF path
img <- image_read(image_path)
pdf_path <- sub("\\.jpg$", ".pdf", image_path, ignore.case = TRUE)

# 5. Create the PDF file (8.5x11 inches)
pdf(file = pdf_path, width = 8.5, height = 11)

# Set page margins directly in inches (bottom, left, top, right)
# We add a little extra to the bottom margin to make space for the caption
bottom_margin <- page_margin_inches + 1.0
par(mai = c(bottom_margin, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches))

# Create a blank plotting area that respects the new margins
plot(0:1, 0:1, type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

# Center the image within the plot area, applying the scale factor
# The plot area is now our "canvas" defined by the margins
x_center <- 0.5
y_center <- 0.5
plot_width <- 1 * image_scale_factor
plot_height <- 1 * image_scale_factor

# Define image coordinates to center it
xleft <- x_center - (plot_width / 2)
ybottom <- y_center - (plot_height / 2)
xright <- x_center + (plot_width / 2)
ytop <- y_center + (plot_height / 2)

rasterImage(img, xleft, ybottom, xright, ytop)

# 6. Add the caption in the bottom margin
# 'line=2' places it 2 lines down from the plot area, 'cex' is character expansion (font size)
mtext(caption_text, side = 1, line = 0, adj = 0.1, cex = 1.4)
mtext(location_text, side = 1, line = 1, adj = 0.1, cex = 0.9)

# 7. Close the PDF device to save the file
dev.off()

# Print a confirmation message
cat("PDF created successfully at:", pdf_path, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Load the required libraries

library(exifr)


# --- User-configurable settings ---

## Whitespace around the image (in inches). 
##    A smaller number means a larger image. Good values are 0.1 to 1.0.
page_margin_inches <- 0.1

## Image scale factor within the margins.
##    1.0 = fill the space completely (up to the margins).
##    0.9 = use 90% of the available space.
image_scale_factor <- 1.0

## Type size for captions
main_caption_size <- 1.4
sub_caption_size <- 0.9

## Where components

where2 <- "City"

# --- Main script ---

image_pdf <- function(image_file,
                      page_margin_inches=0.1,
                      image_scale_factor=1.0,
                      main_caption_size=1.4,
                      sub_caption_size=0.9,
                      main_caption="Event",
                      sub_caption="Where",
                      where1="Location",
                      where2="City"){

# 1. Select the JPG file interactively
image_path <- image_file
if (length(image_path) == 0) {
  stop("No file selected. Please specify file.")
}

## 3. Define the caption text lines.

main_caption_text <- ifelse(

  exif_data[[main_caption]], 
  " " # Default to blank if field doesn't exist
)

sub_caption_text1 <- ifelse(
  !is.null(exif_data[[where1]]), 
  exif_data[[where1]], 
  " " # Default to blank if field doesn't exist
)

sub_caption_text2 <- ifelse(
  !is.null(exif_data[[where2]]),

)

sub_caption_text <- paste0(sub_caption_text1,", ",

## 4. Read the image and define the PDF path

bottom_margin <- page_margin_inches + 1.0
par(mai = c(bottom_margin, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches))

# Create a blank plotting area that respects the new margins.
plot(0:1, 0:1, type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

## Center the image within the plot area, applying the scale factor
## The plot area is now our "canvas" defined by the margins
x_center <- 0.5
y_center <- 0.5
plot_width <- 1 * image_scale_factor
plot_height <- 1 * image_scale_factor

## Define image coordinates to center it

ybottom <- y_center - (plot_height / 2)
xright <- x_center + (plot_width / 2)
ytop <- y_center + (plot_height / 2)

rasterImage(img, xleft, ybottom, xright, ytop)

## 6. Add the caption in the bottom margin
mtext(main_caption_text, side = 1, line = 0, adj = 0.1, 
      cex = main_caption_size)
mtext(sub_caption_text, side = 1, line = 1, adj = 0.1, 
      cex = sub_caption_size)

## 7. Close the PDF device to save the file
dev.off()

## Print a confirmation message
## cat("PDF created successfully at:", pdf_path, "\n")
} ## end image_pdf function

######################################################

## Caption contents
## Fields
##   Description  -- Usually the text describing the photo
##   Event        -- Categorizing variable (e.g., species)

##   Date         -- DMY
##   City
##   Where        -- Combines Location and City
```

Refined

```{r}
# Load the required libraries
library(magick)
library(exifr)

#' Create a PDF from a JPG with EXIF Captions
#'
#' This function takes a JPG image, extracts metadata from its EXIF tags,
#' and creates a letter-sized PDF with the image and captions. It offers
#' flexible captioning and date formatting.
#'
#' @param image_file Path to the input JPG file.
#' @param main_caption_field A single string naming the EXIF field for the main caption.
#'   If a date field (like 'DateTimeOriginal') is used, it will be auto-formatted.
#' @param sub_caption_fields A character vector of EXIF field names for the sub-caption.
#'   The function will combine the text from these fields with commas.
#' @param page_margin_inches Numeric. The size of the whitespace margin in inches.
#' @param image_scale_factor Numeric. Scales the image within the margins (1.0 = fill).
#' @param main_caption_size Numeric. The type size for the main caption.
#' @param sub_caption_size Numeric. The type size for the sub-caption.
#' @return Invisibly returns the path to the created PDF.
#'
image_pdf <- function(image_file,
                      main_caption_field = "Description",
                      sub_caption_fields = c("Location", "City"),
                      page_margin_inches = 0.5,
                      image_scale_factor = 1.0,
                      main_caption_size = 1.2,
                      sub_caption_size = 0.9) {

  # --- 1. Validate Input and Read Data ---
  if (!file.exists(image_file)) {
    stop("File not found: ", image_file)
  }
  exif_data <- read_exif(image_file)
  img <- image_read(image_file)

  # --- 2. Process Captions with Flexibility ---

  ## Main Caption (with Date Formatting)
  main_caption_text <- ""
  if (!is.null(exif_data[[main_caption_field]])) {
    # Check if the requested field looks like a date
    is_date <- grepl("date", main_caption_field, ignore.case = TRUE)
    
    if (is_date) {
      # Attempt to parse and format the date
      date_val <- as.Date(exif_data[[main_caption_field]], format = "%Y:%m:%d")
      main_caption_text <- format(date_val, "%B %e, %Y")
    } else {
      # Use the text as-is
      main_caption_text <- exif_data[[main_caption_field]]
    }
  }

  ## Sub-caption (combines multiple fields)
  sub_caption_parts <- sapply(sub_caption_fields, function(field) {
    exif_data[[field]]
  })
  # Filter out any NULL or empty values and combine them
  sub_caption_text <- paste(Filter(Negate(is.null), sub_caption_parts), collapse = ", ")


  # --- 3. Create PDF and Set Layout ---
  pdf_path <- sub("\\.jpg$", ".pdf", image_file, ignore.case = TRUE)
  pdf(file = pdf_path, width = 8.5, height = 11)

  # Dynamically adjust bottom margin based on how many captions we have
  caption_lines <- c(main_caption_text, sub_caption_text)
  caption_lines <- caption_lines[caption_lines != "" & caption_lines != " "]
  bottom_margin <- page_margin_inches + (length(caption_lines) * 0.5) # Add 0.5" per line
  
  par(mai = c(bottom_margin, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches, page_margin_inches))
  plot(0:1, 0:1, type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

  # --- 4. Place Image ---
  rasterImage(img, 0, 0, 1, 1, interpolate = TRUE)

  # --- 5. Add Captions ---
  if (nchar(main_caption_text) > 1) {
    mtext(main_caption_text, side = 1, line = 0, adj = 0, cex = main_caption_size)
  }
  if (nchar(sub_caption_text) > 1) {
    mtext(sub_caption_text, side = 1, line = 2, adj = 0, cex = sub_caption_size)
  }
  
  # --- 6. Finalize ---
  dev.off()
  cat("PDF created successfully at:", pdf_path, "\n")
  invisible(pdf_path)
}

######################################################
##                  Example Usage                   ##
######################################################

## Define the path to your photo
photo <- "Keepers/A1203427_crop_nik_adj.jpg"

## Run the function with new flexible options

# Example 1: Use 'Description' for main caption and combine 'Location' and 'City' for sub-caption
image_pdf(image_file = photo,
          main_caption_field = "Description",
          sub_caption_fields = c("Location", "City"))

# Example 2: Use a formatted date for the main caption and the 'Event' field for the sub-caption
image_pdf(image_file = photo,
          main_caption_field = "DateTimeOriginal", # This will be auto-formatted
          sub_caption_fields = c("Event"))

# Example 3: Use 'Description' for main caption and just the 'Location' for the sub-caption
image_pdf(image_file = photo,
          main_caption_field = "Description",
          sub_caption_fields = "Location")

```

Make a Book

```{r}

# Load the required libraries
library(exifr)
library(pdftools)

# --- 1. SETUP ---

# Load the function we created previously
source("photo_image_function.R") 

# --- Configuration ---
cover_file <- "cover.pdf"
category_file <- "category_list.txt"
image_folder <- "Keepers" # Correctly points to the subfolder
output_filename <- "Photo_Book.pdf"


# --- 2. MAIN SCRIPT ---

categories <- readLines(category_file)
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
temp_pdf_files <- c()

cat("Starting to process images...\n")

# Loop through each category
for (category in categories) {
  
  cat(paste0("\nLooking for images in category: '", category, "'\n"))
  
  # Loop through each image file
  for (image_file in all_images) {
    
    # *** FIX: Create the full path to the image file ***
    full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
    
    # Read the 'Event' field using the full path
    exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = "Event")
    image_event <- exif_data$Event
    
    if (!is.null(image_event)) {
      if (tolower(image_event) == tolower(category)) {
        
        cat(paste0("  - Found match: ", image_file, "\n"))
        
        # *** FIX: Use the full path when calling the function ***
        new_pdf_path <- image_pdf(
          image_file = full_path,
          main_caption_field = "Description",
          sub_caption_fields = c("Location", "City")
        )
        
        temp_pdf_files <- c(temp_pdf_files, new_pdf_path)
      }
    }
  }
}

# --- 3. COMBINE AND CLEAN UP ---

if (length(temp_pdf_files) > 0) {
  cat("\nAll images processed. Combining PDFs into the final book...\n")

  files_to_combine <- c(cover_file, temp_pdf_files)
  pdf_combine(input = files_to_combine, output = output_filename)

  cat("Cleaning up temporary files...\n")
  file.remove(temp_pdf_files)

  cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your book has been created: '", output_filename, "'\n"))
} else {
  cat("\n--- No matching images were found to create pages. ---\n")
}

```
Now with intro pages

```{r}
# Load the required libraries
library(exifr)
library(pdftools)

# --- 1. SETUP ---

# Load the function we created previously
source("photo_image_function.R") 

# --- Configuration ---
cover_file      <- "cover.pdf"
category_file   <- "category_list.txt"
image_folder    <- "Keepers"
stories_folder  <- "Stories" # <-- New folder for your story PDFs
output_filename <- "Photo_Book.pdf"


# --- 2. MAIN SCRIPT ---

categories <- readLines(category_file)
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)

# This list will hold the final, ordered paths of ALL pages for the book
pages_to_combine <- c(cover_file) 
# This list tracks ONLY the temporary image PDFs that we need to delete later
temp_files_to_delete <- c() 

cat("Starting to build book...\n")

# Loop through each category from your list
for (category in categories) {
  
  cat(paste0("\n--- Processing Category: '", category, "' ---\n"))
  
  # >> NEW: Look for a matching story PDF for this category <<
  story_pdf_path <- file.path(stories_folder, paste0(category, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(story_pdf_path)) {
    pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, story_pdf_path)
    cat(paste0("  + Found and added story page: ", story_pdf_path, "\n"))
  }
  
  # Loop through each image file to find matches
  for (image_file in all_images) {
    
    full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
    exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = "Event")
    image_event <- exif_data$Event
    
    if (!is.null(image_event)) {
      if (tolower(image_event) == tolower(category)) {
        
        cat(paste0("  - Found match: ", image_file, "\n"))
        
        # Create the single-page PDF for the image
        new_pdf_path <- image_pdf(
          image_file = full_path,
          main_caption_field = "Description",
          sub_caption_fields = c("Location", "City")
        )
        
        # Add the new page to our final list AND our temporary delete list
        pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, new_pdf_path)
        temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, new_pdf_path)
      }
    }
  }
}

# --- 3. COMBINE AND CLEAN UP ---

# Check if any pages were added after the cover
if (length(pages_to_combine) > 1) {
  cat("\nAll sections processed. Combining PDFs into the final book...\n")

  pdf_combine(input = pages_to_combine, output = output_filename)

  # Clean up ONLY the temporary image PDFs
  if (length(temp_files_to_delete) > 0) {
    cat("Cleaning up temporary files...\n")
    file.remove(temp_files_to_delete)
  }

  cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your book has been created: '", output_filename, "'\n"))
} else {
  cat("\n--- No matching images or stories were found to create pages. ---\n")
}

```

Adding KML files

```{r}
# Load the required libraries
library(exifr)
library(pdftools)

# --- 1. SETUP ---

# Load the function we created previously
source("photo_image_function.R") 

# --- Configuration ---
cover_file      <- "cover.pdf"
category_file   <- "category_list.txt"
image_folder    <- "Keepers"
stories_folder  <- "Stories"
kml_folder      <- "KML" # <-- New folder for KML files
output_filename <- "Photo_Book.pdf"


# --- 2. MAIN SCRIPT ---

# Create the KML directory if it doesn't already exist
if (!dir.exists(kml_folder)) {
  dir.create(kml_folder)
}

categories <- readLines(category_file)
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)

pages_to_combine <- c(cover_file) 
temp_files_to_delete <- c() 

cat("Starting to build book...\n")

# Loop through each category from your list
for (category in categories) {
  
  cat(paste0("\n--- Processing Category: '", category, "' ---\n"))
  
  # Add story page if it exists
  story_pdf_path <- file.path(stories_folder, paste0(category, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(story_pdf_path)) {
    pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, story_pdf_path)
    cat(paste0("  + Found and added story page: ", story_pdf_path, "\n"))
  }
  
  # >> NEW: List to hold GPS data for the KML file <<
  kml_placemarks <- c()
  
  # Loop through each image file to find matches
  for (image_file in all_images) {
    
    full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
    # Read Event and GPS tags from the image
    tags_to_read <- c("Event", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude", "Description")
    exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
    
    image_event <- exif_data$Event
    
    if (!is.null(image_event)) {
      if (tolower(image_event) == tolower(category)) {
        
        cat(paste0("  - Found match: ", image_file, "\n"))
        
        # Create the single-page PDF for the image
        new_pdf_path <- image_pdf(image_file = full_path)
        pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, new_pdf_path)
        temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, new_pdf_path)
        
        # >> NEW: If GPS data exists, format it for the KML <<
        if (!is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLongitude)) {
          placemark_name <- ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$Description), exif_data$Description, image_file)
          # KML format: longitude,latitude,altitude
          coordinates <- paste(exif_data$GPSLongitude, exif_data$GPSLatitude, 0, sep = ",")
          
          # Create the KML <Placemark> block
          placemark_xml <- paste0(
            "    <Placemark>\n",
            "      <name>", placemark_name, "</name>\n",
            "      <Point>\n",
            "        <coordinates>", coordinates, "</coordinates>\n",
            "      </Point>\n",
            "    </Placemark>"
          )
          kml_placemarks <- c(kml_placemarks, placemark_xml)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # >> NEW: After checking all images, write the KML file for the category <<
  if (length(kml_placemarks) > 0) {
    kml_filename <- file.path(kml_folder, paste0(category, ".kml"))
    
    # Combine header, placemarks, and footer into the final KML content
    kml_content <- c(
      '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>',
      '<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2">',
      '  <Document>',
      paste0('    <name>', category, '</name>'),
      kml_placemarks,
      '  </Document>',
      '</kml>'
    )
    
    # Write the content to the .kml file
    writeLines(kml_content, kml_filename)
    cat(paste0("  + Successfully created KML file: ", kml_filename, "\n"))
  }
}

# --- 3. COMBINE AND CLEAN UP ---
# (This section remains unchanged)
if (length(pages_to_combine) > 1) {
  cat("\nAll sections processed. Combining PDFs into the final book...\n")
  pdf_combine(input = pages_to_combine, output = output_filename)
  if (length(temp_files_to_delete) > 0) {
    cat("Cleaning up temporary files...\n")
    file.remove(temp_files_to_delete)
  }
  cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your book has been created: '", output_filename, "'\n"))
} else {
  cat("\n--- No matching images or stories were found to create pages. ---\n")
}

```

Going for the Leaflet Map

```{r}

# Load required libraries
library(exifr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# --- 1. Configuration ---
image_folder <- "Keepers"
output_map_file <- "Interactive_Event_Map.html"
cat("Configuration loaded.\n")

# --- 2. Data Gathering ---
# This part is similar to our book-building script.
# We'll create a single data frame with all the info we need.

all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
# List to hold the data from each photo
photo_data_list <- list()

cat("Gathering metadata from all images...\n")
for (image_file in all_images) {
  full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
  
  # Read all the tags we might need
  tags_to_read <- c("Event", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude", "Description")
  exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
  
  # Only include photos that have an Event and GPS coordinates
  if (!is.null(exif_data$Event) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude)) {
    photo_data_list[[length(photo_data_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Event = exif_data$Event,
      Lat = exif_data$GPSLatitude,
      Lon = exif_data$GPSLongitude,
      Description = ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$Description), exif_data$Description, "No description."),
      FileName = image_file
    )
  }
}

# Combine the list into a single, clean data frame
photo_data <- do.call(rbind, photo_data_list)
cat(paste("Found", nrow(photo_data), "photos with complete GPS and Event data.\n"))


# --- 3. Map Creation ---

# Get a list of the unique event categories
unique_events <- unique(photo_data$Event)

# Create a color palette function that assigns a color to each event
# The 'viridis' palette is good for color-blind friendliness
pal <- colorFactor(palette = "viridis", domain = unique_events)

# Start building the Leaflet map
# We start with the base data and add layers with the pipe (%>%) operator
event_map <- leaflet(data = photo_data) %>%
  # Add the base map tiles. 'CartoDB.Positron' is a clean, light base map.
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)

cat("Building map layers for each event category...\n")
# Loop through each event type to add it as a separate layer group
for (event_cat in unique_events) {
  # Filter the data for the current category
  category_data <- photo_data[photo_data$Event == event_cat, ]
  
  event_map <- event_map %>%
    # Add circle markers for the current group
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = category_data,
      lng = ~Lon, lat = ~Lat,
      # Define the pop-up content using HTML
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", Description, "</b><br>", FileName),
      radius = 6,
      color = ~pal(Event), # Use our palette to color the circle border
      stroke = TRUE,
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      # This 'group' name is what appears in the layer control
      group = event_cat
    )
}

# --- 4. Add Controls and Save ---

# Add the final map components
event_map <- event_map %>%
  # Add the layer control widget, allowing groups to be toggled
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = unique_events,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) # Keep the control box open
  ) %>%
  # Add a legend to explain the colors
  addLegend(
    pal = pal, 
    values = ~Event, 
    title = "Event Categories",
    opacity = 1
  )

# Save the map to a single, self-contained HTML file
saveWidget(event_map, file = output_map_file, selfcontained = TRUE)

cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your interactive map has been created:\n", output_map_file, "\n"))

```

Revised Leaflet Map

```{r}

# Load required libraries
library(exifr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# --- 1. Configuration ---
image_folder <- "Keepers"
output_map_file <- "Interactive_Event_Map.html"
cat("Configuration loaded.\n")

# --- 2. Data Gathering ---
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
photo_data_list <- list()

cat("Gathering metadata from all images...\n")
for (image_file in all_images) {
  full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
  tags_to_read <- c("Event", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude", "Description")
  exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
  
  if (!is.null(exif_data$Event) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude)) {
    photo_data_list[[length(photo_data_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Event = exif_data$Event,
      Lat = exif_data$GPSLatitude,
      Lon = exif_data$GPSLongitude,
      Description = ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$Description), exif_data$Description, "No description."),
      FileName = image_file
    )
  }
}

photo_data <- do.call(rbind, photo_data_list)
cat(paste("Found", nrow(photo_data), "photos with complete GPS and Event data.\n"))

# --- 3. Map Creation ---
unique_events <- unique(photo_data$Event)

# >> CHANGE 1: Use a "rainbow" color palette for more distinct colors <<
# We generate a color for each unique event.
rainbow_colors <- rainbow(length(unique_events))
pal <- colorFactor(palette = rainbow_colors, domain = unique_events)

# Start building the Leaflet map
event_map <- leaflet(data = photo_data) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)

cat("Building map layers for each event category...\n")
for (event_cat in unique_events) {
  category_data <- photo_data[photo_data$Event == event_cat, ]
  
  event_map <- event_map %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = category_data,
      lng = ~Lon, lat = ~Lat,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", Description, "</b><br>", FileName),
      radius = 6,
      color = ~pal(Event),
      stroke = TRUE,
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      group = event_cat
    )
}

# --- 4. Add Controls and Finalize ---

# Add the layer control widget
event_map <- event_map %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = unique_events,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# >> CHANGE 2: Hide all the groups by default when the map loads <<
for(event_cat in unique_events) {
    event_map <- event_map %>% hideGroup(event_cat)
}

# >> CHANGE 3: The addLegend() function has been removed <<

# Save the map to a single, self-contained HTML file
saveWidget(event_map, file = output_map_file, selfcontained = TRUE)

cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your interactive map has been created:\n", output_map_file, "\n"))

```

Updated Leaflet Map with different basemaps

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(exifr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

# --- 1. Configuration ---
image_folder <- "Keepers"
output_map_file <- "Interactive_Event_Map.html"
cat("Configuration loaded.\n")

# --- 2. Data Gathering ---
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
photo_data_list <- list()

cat("Gathering metadata from all images...\n")
for (image_file in all_images) {
  full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
  tags_to_read <- c("Event", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude", "Description")
  exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
  
  if (!is.null(exif_data$Event) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude)) {
    photo_data_list[[length(photo_data_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Event = exif_data$Event,
      Lat = exif_data$GPSLatitude,
      Lon = exif_data$GPSLongitude,
      Description = ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$Description), exif_data$Description, "No description."),
      FileName = image_file
    )
  }
}

photo_data <- do.call(rbind, photo_data_list)
cat(paste("Found", nrow(photo_data), "photos with complete GPS and Event data.\n"))

# --- 3. Map Creation ---
unique_events <- unique(photo_data$Event)
rainbow_colors <- rainbow(length(unique_events))
pal <- colorFactor(palette = rainbow_colors, domain = unique_events)

# Start building the Leaflet map
event_map <- leaflet(data = photo_data) %>%
  
  # >> CHANGE 1: Add multiple base map layers, each with a unique 'group' name <<
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap, group = "Street Map") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap, group = "Topographic")

cat("Building map layers for each event category...\n")
# Loop through each event type to add it as a separate layer group
for (event_cat in unique_events) {
  category_data <- photo_data[photo_data$Event == event_cat, ]
  
  event_map <- event_map %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = category_data,
      lng = ~Lon, lat = ~Lat,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>", Description, "</b><br>", FileName),
      radius = 6,
      color = ~pal(Event),
      stroke = TRUE,
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      group = event_cat
    )
}

# --- 4. Add Controls and Finalize ---

# Add the layer control widget
event_map <- event_map %>%
  addLayersControl(
    # >> CHANGE 2: Define the 'baseGroups' for the radio buttons <<
    baseGroups = c("Street Map", "Satellite", "Topographic"),
    # The 'overlayGroups' for the checkboxes remain the same
    overlayGroups = unique_events,
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# Hide all the event groups by default when the map loads
for(event_cat in unique_events) {
    event_map <- event_map %>% hideGroup(event_cat)
}

# Save the map to a single, self-contained HTML file
saveWidget(event_map, file = output_map_file, selfcontained = TRUE)

cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your interactive map has been created:\n", output_map_file, "\n"))

```

Adding the confirmation table

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(exifr)
library(pdftools)
library(gt) # <-- Replaces gridExtra

# --- 1. SETUP ---
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
source("photo_image_function.R") 

# --- Configuration ---
cover_file      <- "cover.pdf"
category_file   <- "category_list.txt"
image_folder    <- "Keepers"
stories_folder  <- "Stories"
kml_folder      <- "KML"
output_filename <- "Photo_Book.pdf"

# --- 2. MAIN SCRIPT ---
# This section remains unchanged.
if (!dir.exists(kml_folder)) dir.create(kml_folder)
categories <- readLines(category_file)
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
pages_to_combine <- c(cover_file) 
temp_files_to_delete <- c()
verification_data_list <- list()

cat("Starting to build book...\n")
for (category in categories) {
  cat(paste0("\n--- Processing Category: '", category, "' ---\n"))
  story_pdf_path <- file.path(stories_folder, paste0(category, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(story_pdf_path)) {
    pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, story_pdf_path)
    cat(paste0("  + Found and added story page: ", story_pdf_path, "\n"))
  }
  kml_placemarks <- c()
  for (image_file in all_images) {
    full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
    tags_to_read <- c("Event", "Description", "Location", "City", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude")
    exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
    if (!is.null(exif_data$Event) && tolower(exif_data$Event) == tolower(category)) {
      cat(paste0("  - Found match: ", image_file, "\n"))
      new_pdf_path <- image_pdf(image_file = full_path)
      pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, new_pdf_path)
      temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, new_pdf_path)
      verification_data_list[[length(verification_data_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          File = image_file,
          Event = exif_data$Event %||% "NA",
          Description = exif_data$Description %||% "NA",
          Location = exif_data$Location %||% "NA",
          City = exif_data$City %||% "NA",
          GPS = ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude), "Yes", "No")
      )
      if (!is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLongitude)) {
        placemark_name <- exif_data$Description %||% image_file
        coordinates <- paste(exif_data$GPSLongitude, exif_data$GPSLatitude, 0, sep = ",")
        placemark_xml <- paste0("    <Placemark>\n      <name>", placemark_name, "</name>\n      <Point>\n        <coordinates>", coordinates, "</coordinates>\n      </Point>\n    </Placemark>")
        kml_placemarks <- c(kml_placemarks, placemark_xml)
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(kml_placemarks) > 0) {
    kml_filename <- file.path(kml_folder, paste0(category, ".kml"))
    kml_content <- c('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2">', '  <Document>', paste0('    <name>', category, '</name>'), kml_placemarks, '  </Document>', '</kml>')
    writeLines(kml_content, kml_filename)
    cat(paste0("  + Successfully created KML file: ", kml_filename, "\n"))
  }
}

# --- 3. CREATE DATA TABLE PAGE (using gt) ---
# >> This section has been completely replaced with the 'gt' workflow <<
if (length(verification_data_list) > 0) {
  cat("\nGenerating data verification table with gt...\n")
  verification_df <- do.call(rbind, verification_data_list)
  table_pdf_path <- "temp_table_page.pdf"
  
  # Create a gt table object
  gt_table <- gt(verification_df) %>%
    # Add a title to the table
    tab_header(title = "Data Verification Table") %>%
    # Apply standard table styling options
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.color = "black",
      column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
      table.width = pct(95)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(size = "smaller",
                                v_align = "top"),
              locations = cells_body(columns = everything()))
    
  # Save the gt table directly to a PDF file
  gtsave(gt_table, filename = table_pdf_path)
  
  # Add the new table page to the end of our book
  pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, table_pdf_path)
  temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, table_pdf_path)
}

# --- 4. COMBINE AND CLEAN UP ---
# This section remains unchanged.
if (length(pages_to_combine) > 1) {
  cat("\nAll sections processed. Combining PDFs into the final book...\n")
  pdf_combine(input = pages_to_combine, output = output_filename)
  if (length(temp_files_to_delete) > 0) {
    cat("Cleaning up temporary files...\n")
    file.remove(temp_files_to_delete)
  }
  cat(paste0("\nSuccess! Your book has been created: '", output_filename, "'\n"))
} else {
  cat("\n--- No matching images or stories were found to create pages. ---\n")
}

```

The Final Code

```{r}

# Load required libraries
library(exifr)
library(pdftools)
library(gt) # For the verification table

# --- 1. SETUP ---
# Defines a helper function to handle NULL values
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
# Load the function that creates individual image pages
source("photo_image_function.R") 

# --- Configuration ---
cover_file      <- "cover.pdf"
category_file   <- "category_list.txt"
image_folder    <- "Keepers"
stories_folder  <- "Stories"
kml_folder      <- "KML"
output_filename <- "Photo_Book.pdf"
map_script_file <- "make_map.R" # The name of your map script

# --- 2. MAIN SCRIPT ---
# This section remains unchanged and builds the main PDF content.
if (!dir.exists(kml_folder)) dir.create(kml_folder)
categories <- readLines(category_file)
all_images <- list.files(image_folder, pattern = "\\.jpg$", ignore.case = TRUE)
pages_to_combine <- c(cover_file) 
temp_files_to_delete <- c()
verification_data_list <- list()

cat("Starting to build book...\n")
for (category in categories) {
  cat(paste0("\n--- Processing Category: '", category, "' ---\n"))
  story_pdf_path <- file.path(stories_folder, paste0(category, ".pdf"))
  if (file.exists(story_pdf_path)) {
    pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, story_pdf_path)
    cat(paste0("  + Found and added story page: ", story_pdf_path, "\n"))
  }
  kml_placemarks <- c()
  for (image_file in all_images) {
    full_path <- file.path(image_folder, image_file)
    tags_to_read <- c("Event", "Description", "Location", "City", "GPSLatitude", "GPSLongitude")
    exif_data <- read_exif(full_path, tags = tags_to_read)
    if (!is.null(exif_data$Event) && tolower(exif_data$Event) == tolower(category)) {
      cat(paste0("  - Found match: ", image_file, "\n"))
      new_pdf_path <- image_pdf(image_file = full_path)
      pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, new_pdf_path)
      temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, new_pdf_path)
      verification_data_list[[length(verification_data_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          File = image_file,
          Event = exif_data$Event %||% "NA",
          Description = exif_data$Description %||% "NA",
          Location = exif_data$Location %||% "NA",
          City = exif_data$City %||% "NA",
          GPS = ifelse(!is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude), "Yes", "No")
      )
      if (!is.null(exif_data$GPSLatitude) && !is.null(exif_data$GPSLongitude)) {
        placemark_name <- exif_data$Description %||% image_file
        coordinates <- paste(exif_data$GPSLongitude, exif_data$GPSLatitude, 0, sep = ",")
        placemark_xml <- paste0("    <Placemark>\n      <name>", placemark_name, "</name>\n      <Point>\n        <coordinates>", coordinates, "</coordinates>\n      </Point>\n    </Placemark>")
        kml_placemarks <- c(kml_placemarks, placemark_xml)
      }
    }
  }
  if (length(kml_placemarks) > 0) {
    kml_filename <- file.path(kml_folder, paste0(category, ".kml"))
    kml_content <- c('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '<kml xmlns="http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2">', '  <Document>', paste0('    <name>', category, '</name>'), kml_placemarks, '  </Document>', '</kml>')
    writeLines(kml_content, kml_filename)
    cat(paste0("  + Successfully created KML file: ", kml_filename, "\n"))
  }
}

# --- 3. CREATE DATA TABLE PAGE ---
# >> CHANGE 1: Using your preferred 'gt' table code <<
if (length(verification_data_list) > 0) {
  cat("\nGenerating data verification table with gt...\n")
  verification_df <- do.call(rbind, verification_data_list)
  table_pdf_path <- "temp_table_page.pdf"
  
  # Create a gt table object using your formatting
  gt_table <- gt(verification_df) %>%
    tab_header(title = "Data Verification Table") %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.color = "black",
      column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
      table.width = pct(95)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(size = "smaller", v_align = "top"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = everything())
    )
    
  # Save the gt table directly to a PDF file
  gtsave(gt_table, filename = table_pdf_path)
  
  pages_to_combine <- c(pages_to_combine, table_pdf_path)
  temp_files_to_delete <- c(temp_files_to_delete, table_pdf_path)
}

# --- 4. COMBINE AND CLEAN UP ---
if (length(pages_to_combine) > 1) {
  cat("\nAll sections processed. Combining PDFs into the final book...\n")
  pdf_combine(input = pages_to_combine, output = output_filename)
  if (length(temp_files_to_delete) > 0) {

  }

} else {

}
```
